Chapter 7144: I Wanted To Protect

Chapter 7144: I Wanted To Protect

“No... I just wanted to protect a little longer...” Worldbearer Tortoise shouted with despair. Tears streamed down his cheeks before he turned to dust.

If he hadn’t burned his true fate and body, he would have survived the attack. Spectators became frozen upon seeing this.

His last words echoed in their ears, imprinting his selflessness into their mind forever.

“Tortoise Immortal...” They fell to the ground in mourning. Some emperors and ancient ancestors have not cried for who knows how long until now.

“Brother...” Apex picked up a shell that had fallen near him with trembling hands.

“He’s gone.” Hao Cai bowed deeply at the shell.

“Elder.” Stone Immortal and the monarch lamented.

After his death, the divine beasts returned and shouted: “Divine Beast Seal.”

The seal returned, trapping firmaments and living beings’ bloodlines. The portal shattered in the blink of an eye, so no one had time to run.

“Go.” Apex, Hao Cai, and Ninth Lady didn’t belong to Divine Firmament. They have tried their best to no avail. Thus, they decided to run.

However, the other divine beasts prevented them from running since the seal was still effective against other cultivators.

“Stick around, Fellow Daoists.” Kun Peng uttered coldly.

The group exchanged glances, wondering if they should split up for a better chance of survival.

“No.” Apex shook his head. Under normal circumstances, splitting up could increase their odds but in this case, Divine Firmament was sealed.

“What do you want?” Hao Cai asked.

“Nothing much, just looking at three nice lambs before the calamity.” Death Serpent said.

“You three jumped into the net, we didn’t want to catch you.” Lunar Wolf said.

“No need for bullshit justification, just be direct.” Ninth Lady laughed.

“What you’re doing right now is no different from falling to the darkness, the same as Devouring Alliance.” Apex said.

“It’s not that we want to eat you but the children will be starving after the calamity, we are responsible as providers.” Gluttonous Beast said.

“So don’t worry about us, we haven’t fallen yet.” Lunar Wolf laughed.

“Even if we do, so what? If that’s the only way to survive the calamity.” Death Serpent said.

“Surrender or futile resistance?” Kun Peng asked: “The latter will be more painful.”

“We’ll see about that, I’ll kill you all!” Ninth Lady charged in but Apex held her back.

Teamwork was the only way they could survive.

“Be free from foolish fantasy, no one is leaving Divine Firmament, all will become our food for winter.” Kun Peng said.

“No one is leaving? What about me?” A drifting voice interrupted the tense exchange.
